name: GStack
tagline: 23 opinionated tools that turn Claude Code into a virtual engineering team — CEO, designer, eng manager, QA, security, release engineer, and more.
description: GStack is Garry Tan's complete software factory for Claude Code. 23 specialized skills that run in sprint order: Think → Plan → Build → Review → Test → Ship → Reflect. Each skill feeds into the next. /office-hours reframes your product before code. /plan-ceo-review challenges scope. /plan-eng-review locks architecture. /design-review catches AI slop. /qa finds bugs with a real browser. /ship handles release. /retro reflects on what shipped. Includes GBrain for persistent knowledge, /browse for real Chromium, /pair-agent for multi-AI coordination, and /cso for security audits.
author: garrytan
suitable_for: Founders and CEOs who still want to ship
Tech leads wanting rigorous review and QA
